threads.body: [General] This task enables `otel.instrumentation.pulsar.experimental-span-attributes=true`, but labels collected metadata only with the semconv setting. As a result, metadata from this task can add `messaging.pulsar.message.type` to the same condition used by `testBothSemconv`, even though that task explicitly disables the Pulsar experimental attributes. Include both active settings in `metadataConfig` so the generated metadata remains configuration-specific.
